description: Election Commission - Notice declaring the name of Mr. H. Y. L. Padmasiri as the member of the ward II Dikella of Dehiovita Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Dehiowita Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local government body, specifically the declaration of a newly elected member to fill the vacant seat. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for government bodies.
